findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tesi_upload_file" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tesi_ask · Private data: tesi_usage, tesi_claim_key, tesi_prepare_topup, tesi_files_list, tesi_upload_file, tesi_download_file · Public sink: tesi_upload_file · Destructive: tesi_ask, tesi_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tesi_ask · Private data: tesi_usage, tesi_claim_key, tesi_prepare_topup, tesi_files_list, tesi_upload_file, tesi_download_file · Public sink: tesi_upload_file · Destructive: tesi_ask, tesi_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
